title: Prime-to-characteristic roots in a separably closed field
statement: Let $K$ be a separably closed field [def-kun-separably-closed] [def-weil-field]. Let $m\geq1$ be an integer whose image in $K$ is nonzero. Then every $x\in K$ has an $m$-th root in $K$: there exists $y\in K$ with $y^m=x$.
